experiment: v46 native-M1 initialization plus v45 fixed-grid single-coordinate integer repair
model_setting: User requested Luna Max; current interface does not expose a verifiable model-setting switch or identity, so setting cannot be confirmed.
comparison: M1 vs R1, M2 vs R2, R2 vs R1; initializers differ and native grids may differ; not a code-only controlled contrast.
recovery: fresh independent M1 model only; no M2/R2 weights, grid, codes, activation cache, or repair states
algorithm: Byte-identical v45 repair_v45.batch_repair and precision_check; no algorithm edits. ±1 legal code moves, 32 accepted updates, 128*d eval cap, v45 tie and threshold, rejection blacklist, FP32 strict-decline and frozen FP64 recovery.
grid: Per-module trusted M1 FP32 scales/zeros/g_idx from its own full-model layer checkpoints; selected alpha must equal1; native g_idx=column//128; zeros=8; effective codes recovered only by unique bitwise enumeration over all legal codes 0..15.
objective: Same-input local reconstruction objective; pristine FP16 dense model weights as target; X from R1 current prefix; full undamped C; actual FP16-dequant delta.
dependency_order: qkv -> o -> up/gate -> down -> next block; one group commit before downstream capture.

quantization.scope: all 168 decoder Linear modules; embeddings, tied lm_head, norms, and biases remain FP16
quantization.math: FP32 GPTQ statistics and compensation; dense quantized weights stored FP16

evaluation.primary_representation: dense-dequant FP16 weights for M1 and M2; original FP16 for M0
evaluation.c4_label: C4 validation fixed token budget PPL; not standard/full C4 PPL

cost_gate.source: v45 measured full layers with new_groups=4 in BLOCK_TIMINGS.csv
cost_gate.note: FP64 allowance is a conservative planning assumption inherited from v45; not measured for M1.

evaluation_rule: Only once each WT2 test and fixed-budget C4 validation after final code/grid/config/reload checks and checkpoint lock. No P3.
stop: Stop after this single R1; no new model or parameter tuning.
freeze_scope: Protocol/source and implementation frozen before GPU warmup; all edits thereafter are result records only.
runtime_substitutions_only: M1 initialization checkpoint, R1 output paths, and R1 model hash path; core search function lives in byte-identical repair_v45.py.
